messages:
maria: Heads-up on PR #3678 — docs preview failed linkcheck (3 anchors) and vale flagged multiple lines in migrations/upgrade-1-2.md (rw-passive-voice). Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/3678 — anyone able to triage? @sam?

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck: 3 broken internal anchors detected in docs/migrations/upgrade-1-2.md: #upgrade-steps, #post-migrate.
Vale: 6 matches for rule 'rw-passive-voice' in the same file.
Run locally: `yarn docs:preview --file docs/migrations/upgrade-1-2.md`

sam: I can take the anchors. Sending preview link to open now. Looks like some headings were renamed in the TOC migration.

kevin: New vale rules rolled in last release (1.23) — 'rw-passive-voice' is stricter. Some hits look like false positives (e.g., "Steps to be completed" -> flagged). We have two options: 1) reword to satisfy vale, or 2) add inline vale ignore comments for these blocks and follow up with rules team. I prefer rewording if it's small.

priya: I can push quick fixes for the 3 anchors and any obvious grammar bits. But if we add ignores we should note them in PR description for audit.

olivia: If rewording is safe (no content change), do that. For the migration guide we should avoid exceptions unless necessary. I can rephrase a couple sentences.

priya: Prep patch: I'll update the anchors and change sentences like "should be migrated" -> "migrate". Also fix two broken links pointing at /old-anchors.

sam: pushed branch `docs/pr-3678-anchors` with anchor fixes and a note about an external blog link 404 (author to confirm). Preview rerun requested.

maria: Plan: priya and olivia reword + anchor fixes now. sam will watch external link. kevin will rerun vale on preview. If green, merge during Friday merge window (09:00-10:00 UTC). If vale still complains, add `<!--vale: ignore-->` above the affected block as a last resort.

docs-ci-bot: Queued preview rerun for branch docs/pr-3678-anchors.

kevin: Running local vale check now: `./bin/vale --config=.vale.ini docs/migrations/upgrade-1-2.md`

priya: pushed edits for wording + link fixes in commit 2. Small diff:
```
- Steps to be completed after upgrade
+ Steps to complete after upgrade
```
and added redirect to the TOC anchor for `#post-migrate`.

sam: anchor commit applied. Also added a short note in PR about the external blog 404 for follow-up.

docs-ci-bot: Preview results: linkcheck -> PASSED; vale -> 1 match remaining in a note block. Automatic suggestion: add `<!--vale: ignore-->` above the note.

maria: Looks good. Priya + Sam ty! Kevin please watch the merge window and merge if green. If vale remains, use the inline ignore and mention it in PR for later rule review.

kevin: Will do. If I end up adding ignore I'll include a changelog entry so docs-standards can evaluate the rule.

docs-ci-bot: Action: added inline ignore `<!--vale: ignore-->` to the note block in commit 3 (ci-autofix). Final preview: PASS.

maria: :thumbsup: Merging scheduled for Fri 09:15 UTC. Thanks everyone.

olivia: Great — I'll open a small follow-up issue to revisit the vale rule scope on migration docs.

kevin: Merge done at 09:18 UTC during window. Closing thread. :shipit:
